title: USB installer/controller runtime settings
description: Structured contract for the values currently stored in autoinstall-usb/bootstrap/installer.env. Phase 2 replaces the sourced env file with strict KEY=VALUE parsing against this schema; this file is the validated (YAML/JSON) representation used for linting and future rendering.

EXCLUDE_UUID.description: Filesystem UUIDs or PARTUUIDs that must never be selected as an install/repair target.

CHECK_UUID.description: When multiple OS roots exist, the exact UUID to treat as the intended supervisor root. Empty string means unset.

SEED_URL.description: Base URL of the NoCloud cloud-init seed directory served over HTTPS.

CONFIG_VERSION.description: Desired configuration version. Integer initially; may later be a Git commit SHA (40 hex chars).

DRY_RUN.description: Global safety rule #4: DRY_RUN is the default until the physical installation phase is accepted.
